question: What consequence should be declared when the eightfold bond of the liṅga becomes loosened?
premises: The eightfold bond may become loosened
The condition of the liṅga relates to the kingdom
inference: Looseness of the eightfold bond should be declared as indicating looseness in the kingdom
plain_english: When the eightfold bond is loosened, one should declare looseness in the kingdom.
